description_en: Imports a Thing Specification Language (TSL) model for a specified product
description_zh: 调用该接口为指定产品导入物模型
name: ImportThingModelTsl

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the Overview page in the IoT Platform console, view the ID of the current instance.

<notice>
If this ID value is available, you must specify it. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no Overview page or ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The resource group ID.

<notice>IoT Platform currently supports resource group management only at the instance level. The request parameter ResourceGroupId is no longer valid and does not need to be specified.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
资源组ID。

<notice>目前，物联网平台仅支持实例维度的资源组管理。请求参数ResourceGroupId配置已无效，无需再传入。
</notice>
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product.
You can view the ProductKey on the Products page in the IoT Platform console, or call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html to obtain the value
parameters.help_zh:
产品的ProductKey。
可以在物联网平台控制台产品页查看，或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html查看ProductKey的取值
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The Thing Specification Language (TSL) model that you have edited. The value is a JSON string. The TSL model of a product includes the definitions of properties, services, and events.
The TslStr value must be in the standard TSL data format. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73727.html.

This parameter is currently required. You can import a TSL model only by using TslStr
parameters.help_zh:
您编辑的物模型（TSL）。JSON格式的字符串。产品的物模型（TSL）包含属性、服务和事件的定义。
TslStr格式需为标准的物模型数据格式，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73727.html。

目前该参数为必填参数，只能通过TslStr导入物模型
parameters.name: tsl_str

parameters.help_en:
The URI of the TSL model stored in Object Storage Service (OSS).

This parameter is currently not supported. Use TslStr to import a TSL model
parameters.help_zh:
物模型数据在对象存储（OSS）上的存储地址URI。

目前该参数暂时无效，请传入TslStr导入物模型
parameters.name: tsl_url

parameters.help_en:
The identifier of a custom module in the TSL model. The identifier must be unique within the product. It can contain uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_), and cannot exceed 30 characters.

This parameter must be used together with FunctionBlockName. If this parameter is not specified, the default module is imported
parameters.help_zh:
物模型自定义模块标识符，在产品中具有唯一性。支持英文大小写字母、数字和下划线（_），不超过30个字符。

需与FunctionBlockName结合使用。不传入此参数时，导入默认模块
parameters.name: function_block_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of a custom module in the TSL model. The name can contain Chinese characters, English letters, Japanese characters, digits, and underscores (_). The name must be 4 to 30 characters in length. A Chinese character or a Japanese character counts as one character.

This parameter must be used together with FunctionBlockId. If this parameter is not specified, the default module is imported
parameters.help_zh:
物模型的自定义模块名称。支持中文、英文字母、日文、数字和下划线（_），长度限制为4～30个字符，一个中文、一个日文算1个字符。

需与FunctionBlockId结合使用。不传入此参数时，导入默认模块
parameters.name: function_block_name

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
